Legacy Authority Retirement and Bundle Disposition

consolidationTest: A package earns its own id only if it delivers a capability that can be exercised and proved on its own. A package cut along an artefact boundary, a taxonomy class, or a staging step is a fragment and must be merged into the capability it serves.
reCheckedVerdict: 16 is the minimal dependency-driven plan. Applying the consolidation test a second time yields exactly one near-miss (K1+K2, both wave 1), and separating them is justified: K1 exits on a HUMAN dossier approval with a pinned hash, K2 exits on a CI job. Merging would gate an automated check behind a human signature and make the wave-1 exit ambiguous. The three the plan already declares unmergeable remain so: K7 (its safety property is a static-analysis proof over the minting code, destroyed if another minting path lands in the same change), K11 (must prove 0 contract diffs against shipped C9), K14 (~45 individually recorded command decisions, not batchable).
